final: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry GROUP BY t.equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate FROM status_averages), kept AS (SELECT a.avg_pulse_rate, a.avg_pulse_rate - m.mean_rate AS excess_first FROM status_averages AS a CROSS JOIN first_mean AS m WHERE a.avg_pulse_rate > m.mean_rate), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate FROM kept) SELECT AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_pulse_rate, AVG(k.excess_first) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - m.mean_rate) AS avg_excess_second FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m WHERE k.avg_pulse_rate > m.mean_rate
